high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by Joe Biden's official account (@joebiden). The post features a photograph of Joe Biden and Kamala Harris walking together on a stage with the American flag prominently displayed in the background. There are also other flags to the left of the American flag, including what appears to be the flag of the United States Virgin Islands. The text in the post reads: "On this day last year, @KamalaHarris was announced as our pick to join the ticket for vice president—a historic selection for a historic election.
